title: User-supplied niche-bending TikTok
review_method: Earlier full captions and sampled video frames
finding: Useful niche research; production omitted; income not independently verified.

title: SmartBloom AI: Automated video pipeline
review_method: Full on-page transcript and description read; playback stalled
finding: FFmpeg batch stitching is feasible; copying creators' hook clips is not the production model recommended here.

title: Pouya Eti: Claude Code and Remotion
review_method: Full on-page transcript and description read; playback stalled
finding: Code-generated motion graphics and iterative visual fixes; not a demonstrated five-channel production service.

title: Kreelux: Roblox Shorts with Claude and Blender
review_method: Full on-page transcript and description read; playback stalled
finding: Storyboard, word timings, reusable rigs, preview and shot repair; tutorial uses ElevenLabs and a two-minute example.

title: snskr28/yt-autopilot
review_method: README and selected source files inspected
finding: Windows orchestration, local Kokoro, saved stages; one-channel assumptions, plan limits and outdated API notes need changes.

title: Saggyishere/video-pipeline
finding: Windows pipeline; local Kokoro explicit selection; normal narrator defaults to ElevenLabs; estimated captions and no live browsing.

title: Automated Video Generator
review_method: README, package.json, .env.example and MCP setup inspected; application not executed
finding: Useful modular CLI/MCP; remove network voice fallbacks, optional cloud providers and third-party publishing service.

title: Automated Video Generator public demo
review_method: Downloaded eight-second public GIF; six frames inspected
finding: The inspected demo has large unused portrait-frame regions, small captions and generic text. It is not proof of premium output.

title: Melvynx/video-agent-skills
finding: Editing and reusable studio ideas; several research/publishing/dubbing/image features require optional services.

title: psabbagh/watch-skill
review_method: README and MIT license inspected; skill not installed or tested
finding: Candidate reference-analysis component using captions/local transcription and scene frames; still consumes agent inference.

title: MadeByAdi/watch-with-claude
finding: Local whisper.cpp fork still documents paid API fallbacks when keys are set; prevent fallback in a zero-spend design.

title: Claude Code: programmatic execution
finding: CLI -p and JSON schema output; handle errors and missing structured output. Bare mode does not use subscription login.

title: Claude Code: legal and authentication
finding: Native individual use and usage limits differ from a third-party service; do not treat subscription access as unlimited API capacity.

title: Kokoro-82M model card
finding: 82-million-parameter open-weight TTS; Apache-licensed weights; useful local narration candidate.

title: Kokoro voices
finding: Selected voice IDs exist; audition locally before finalizing channel voices.

title: WhisperX
review_method: Maintainer README and alignment limitations read
finding: Forced alignment improves word timings; numbers and out-of-dictionary terms still need handling; model licenses are separate.

title: Remotion license FAQ
finding: Individuals and qualifying teams of up to three can use its Free License, including automation; recheck eligibility if organization grows.

title: Ollama structured outputs
finding: Local API supports JSON schemas; validate returned content independently.

title: Ollama integration with Claude Code
finding: Claude Code can be an interface for Ollama models; that does not make a local model the Claude model. Full agent context is costly.

title: Ollama local FAQ
finding: Local-only mode disables cloud features; use bounded context and inspect actual CPU/GPU placement.

title: YouTube channel monetization policies
finding: Original substance and meaningful variety; restrictions on generic mass production and AI personas giving sensitive-topic advice.

title: YouTube GenAI disclosure
finding: Assess realistic synthetic content; scripting help alone is not the same as realistic synthetic footage.

title: YouTube videos.insert
finding: OAuth upload; explicit privacy, audience and synthetic-media settings; do not rely on legacy private-only restriction.

title: YouTube quota calculator
finding: Current default buckets: 100 searches/day, 100 video uploads/day and 10,000 units/day for other endpoints; actual project quotas must be checked.

title: YouTube API revision history
finding: November 2, 2026 removes the unverified-project private-only rule; current examples must not inherit older assumptions.

title: YouTube mid-roll eligibility
finding: Mid-roll eligibility starts at eight minutes on monetized videos; an eligible slot does not guarantee an ad.

title: Pexels license
finding: Free imagery with restrictions; preserve item provenance and avoid implying endorsement.

title: NASA media usage
finding: Check credits and third-party material; acknowledge NASA and avoid implied endorsement.

title: FLUX.2 klein 4B model card
finding: Apache-2.0; advertised standard setup starts around 13 GB VRAM. Low-memory quantization needs its own benchmark.

title: FFmpeg filters
review_method: Official documentation and installed loudnorm help checked
finding: Encoding, mixing and loudness processing are suitable local components.
